- [攻](攻.md) and [撃](撃.md) include attack or aggression; an invasion can involve attack, but their meanings are not identical. [入](入.md) means enter or put in: entry alone does not imply intrusion. These direct quiz exclusions are conservative, not universal synonym claims.

## Meaning and origin

討 concerns going after something, either an enemy or a problem.
[討つ](../words/討つ.md) うつ is the native verb for attacking, defeating,
conquering or avenging, and [検討](../words/検討.md) けんとう is
consideration, examination or review. 討伐 とうばつ is subjugation by
military force, 討議 とうぎ is a debate or discussion, and 討論 とうろん is
also a debate or discussion.

The Digital Daijisen character entry gives two senses: attacking and
subduing an enemy, as in 討伐, and probing a problem thoroughly, as in 討議
and 検討. It lists うつ and たずねる as kun readings. たずねる is not in
KANJIDIC2 or the official Joyo table, so practice does not select it.
title: attack; go on the offensive

侵す is a transitive verb; its dictionary senses also include harming or afflicting. The kun reading remains in the source metadata, but is not selected for practice because 侵す has no linked word article here. This is not a claim that the reading is rare or invalid.

- [犯](犯.md) also has 犯す おかす, including breaking or violating a rule. [冒](冒.md) has 冒す おかす and a harm or affliction sense shared with 侵す. [害](害.md) concerns harm; these pairs are excluded to avoid broad English-choice ambiguity, not to assert the words are interchangeable.

損 concerns loss, damage or disadvantage. 損 そん can describe losing out, while 損害 そんがい names damage or loss. The native verbs 損なう そこなう and 損ねる そこねる can describe harm; attached to another verb stem, related forms can express failing to do something.
kunyomi: [ほぼ, はぶ.く, おか.す, おさ.める, はかりごと, はか.る]

略 concerns abbreviation, omission and a shortened outline. Its range also includes strategy and taking or plundering; the reading examples here focus on abbreviation and approximation rather than trying to turn every source gloss into an everyday standalone word.
